thread:
kyle: Heads up — after yesterday's routing change I see a bunch of quota spikes attributed to the wrong project. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/dashboards/auth-routing

maria: :eyes: saw that too, looks like some requests are being tagged with org=anon instead of origin project

raman: Can you paste an example request header? maybe X-Orig-Project or token claim mismatch

kyle: sample from logs:\n```\nX-Redwood-Auth: sa-zzzz\nX-Orig-Project: proj_123\nX-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4\n```\nbut telemetry shows project=null and quota billed to proj_000

elaine: That's the old fallback. Routing policy now has `delegate_to_org` true, maybe our attribution code hits the fallback when header order differs

kyle: interesting — the change was in routing policy JSON:\n```\n{\"match\": [{\"header\":\"X-Orig-Project\"}], \"fallback\": \"org-lookup\", \"delegate_to_org\": true}\n```\n
raman: if delegate_to_org flips a codepath that prioritizes exchange tokens over explicit headers, could lose project claim when sa token is present

maria: quick query I ran in bigquery:\n`SELECT count(1) FROM telemetry WHERE project IS NULL AND route=\'api-gen\' AND ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)` => 8423

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-298 auth-routing-misattribution

elaine: We should canary the policy and restore previous ordering. If we rollback, need to avoid double-charge window

kyle: Agreed. Proposed immediate action: 1) toggle canary flag to off for 20% traffic, 2) backfill attribution for those missing using token introspect logs, 3) create alert for sudden project-null rate > 100/hr

raman: On it — toggling feature flag in console: `ffctl set auth-routing-order v2 off --env prod` — doing now :wrench:

maria: ping when done, I'll watch the dashboard

raman: flag toggle complete at 1769977150

ops-bot: deploy noticed: auth-routing-config v2 rolled back by raman

maria: dashboard numbers dropping already, project-null down to 1400 in 30m

elaine: I'll open a PR to make attribution precedence explicit and add unit tests. Also add a telemetry tag so we can filter these by routing-policy-version

kyle: thanks. follow-up: run a backfill job with `scripts/backfill_attribution --from 2026-03-20T00:00Z --to now --filter \"route=api-gen\"` and patch billing if needed

maria: noted. closing incident if numbers stable for 2 hours :lock:

kyle: filing retro with timeline and suggested fixes\n
